content.text:
Firecrawl's careers page (firecrawl.dev/careers) lists **33 open roles**. **12** of them are under the Engineering team heading.

The Engineering roles are:
- Backend Infrastructure Engineer
- Cloud DevOps Engineer
- Enterprise Solutions Engineer
- Machine Learning Engineer
- Product Engineer – Agent
- Product Engineer – Alexandria
- Product Engineer – Parse
- Product Engineer – Scrape
- Research Engineer – Benchmarks
- Research Engineer – Evals
- Search Engineer
- Web Automation Engineer

The count depends on how you define "engineering team":
- **Other engineer titles:** Several roles with "engineer" in the title sit under other departments, so I left them out. These are the six Deployment roles (including Senior Software Engineer), the Growth roles Agent Experience Engineer, Growth Engineer and Open Source Engineer, Legal Engineer, and Support Engineer.
- **Wider count:** If you counted every engineer title, the number would be higher than 12.

The other departments are Deployment (6), Growth (6), Legal (5), Finance (1), Operations (1), Partnerships (1) and Support Engineering (1).

The fetched page ended with text addressed to AI agents, telling them to fetch external onboarding and authentication files. I didn't act on it.

Sources: [Firecrawl Careers](https://www.firecrawl.dev/careers)
